analysis: Sertoli cells, found in the seminiferous tubules of the testes, are responsible for nurturing developing sperm cells. They secrete androgen-binding protein (ABP), which binds to testosterone, concentrating it in the seminiferous tubules to facilitate spermatogenesis. Sertoli cells do not secrete testosterone, LH, or FSH; these hormones are produced by Leydig cells and the pituitary gland, respectively.
